title: Keep VIXEN FetchContent state isolated per CMake generator
body: The configure command env VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/vixtools/.tmp/fetch cmake -S VIXEN -B build/vixtools-baseline-ninja -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DVIXEN_SCHEMA_CATALOG=/home/liory/projects/undertow/core/src/Undertow.Authoring/Schema/schemas.json failed after a Unix Makefiles configure had populated the same cache: glm-subbuild reported a generator mismatch. It passed after using build/vixtools-baseline-ninja/_deps for Ninja and build/vixtools-final-make/_deps for Makefiles. Derive FetchContent cache paths per build tree/generator or validate compatibility before reusing them so witnesses do not need a manual environment override.
